findings.detail: Runtime admission validator recognizes old acceptedContent binding only; R7 uses acceptedRecordSnapshot.
Card selector expects numeric priority; R7-W8 uses governed priority object with tier/tieBreakers.
W4 governance rules are accepted, but no executable Gate Base -> semantic tag evidence records exist.
Report/check scripts still contain pre-R7 wording and Chiron D11 expectations.
Generated ECR authority bundle must be regenerated after runtime authority changes.
